How we know

The club’s home page gives the Wednesday and Saturday 7:30 am start at the Pueblo del Sol parking lot, and its Upcoming Events page lists 2026 club events dated Oct 2 through Dec 19 (fetched Sept 30, 2026). The dated entries are club events, not the weekly ride itself.

For visitors

The club’s page says anyone can become a member and ride with the group, and that it leaves no rider behind. Many members have disabilities, and support riders go along. Routes change from ride to ride, so ask the club through its Contact page.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Pace isn’t posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you’re new when you arrive. It’s no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That’s the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the VeloVets Wednesday and Saturday Rides group ride

VeloVets Wednesday and Saturday Rides is a social group ride in Sierra Vista, AZ. It rolls wednesdays and Saturdays at 7:30 am from Sierra Vista Golf Center at Pueblo del Sol (parking lot).

A veterans’ cycling club in Sierra Vista that rides twice a week, all year, from the Pueblo del Sol golf center parking lot. The club calls itself 119 veterans on bicycles, many with disabilities, with support riders alongside. Each ride has a coffee stop and conversation, and anyone can ride with them.
